plumbing.ai/estimates:mine: The browser's balance check before it asks for AI work. The server holds the same figures when the work runs (lib/pricing/estimate.ts).
plumbing.apiKeys/actions:encryptAndSave: User API keys never reach the assistant (plan decision 5).
plumbing.apiKeys/mutations:markUsed: User API keys never reach the assistant (plan decision 5).
plumbing.apiKeys/mutations:remove: User API keys never reach the assistant (plan decision 5).
plumbing.assistant/files:cited: The PDFs a reply cites whose messages the panel hasn't loaded, for its page citations to open them. The assistant reads files through assistant/files:read.
plumbing.assistant/files:remove: Removes a file the person attached and hasn't sent. The assistant doesn't attach files.
plumbing.assistant/files:startUpload: Starts an upload of a file the person attaches to a message, for a token their browser holds. The assistant reads attached files; it doesn't attach its own.
plumbing.assistant/jobs:card: A job's live card in the chat that started it. The assistant reads the same job through screening/queries:getScreeningJob and extraction/queries:listJobResults.
plumbing.assistant/jobs:running: Which of a chat's jobs are running, for the panel to dock their live cards. The assistant hears when each ends, and reads them through screening/queries:getScreeningJob and extraction/queries:listJobResults.
plumbing.assistant/replies:answer: The person's answer to a call the assistant asked about. Only the person asked can give it.
plumbing.assistant/replies:carryOn: Carries on a reply that paused at a spending limit. Only the person whose credits it spends does that.
plumbing.assistant/replies:live: The reply being written now, for the chat page to show as it arrives.
plumbing.assistant/replies:outcome: How the chat's last reply ended, for the assistant's mark in the panel while no reply is being written.
plumbing.assistant/replies:send: Sending a message is how a person asks the assistant; it doesn't message itself.
plumbing.assistant/replies:stop: Stops the reply being written. Only a person watching it does that.
plumbing.assistant/spending:get: The person's own spending limit in a chat, for the panel's Spending sheet.
plumbing.assistant/spending:jobs: The person's calls in a chat that held credits, for the panel's Spending sheet.
plumbing.assistant/spending:setAllowance: Whether jobs that spend credits run in a chat without the person being asked, and the most one may hold. The assistant doesn't set its own.
plumbing.assistant/spending:setForNewChats: Whether the person's new chats take this chat's spending limit. The assistant doesn't set its own.
plumbing.assistant/spending:setReplyLimit: The person's limit on what the assistant spends of their credits. The assistant doesn't set its own.
plumbing.assistant/spending:setTool: Whether web searches or reads of attached files run in a chat without the person being asked. The assistant doesn't allow its own.
plumbing.assistant/threads:newChatModel: The model the panel shows for a chat that does not exist yet. The assistant works inside a chat, which reads its own model through assistant/threads:get.
plumbing.assistant/undo:run: Undoes a step the assistant took, by running the reversing action the step kept. The assistant runs that action itself.
plumbing.billing/accounts:myLimits: What the person's plan allows, for the extraction page to size its bucket. Every start checks the plan itself (convex/billing/accounts.ts `planLimit`).
plumbing.billing/catalog:get: The plan catalog the billing pages render from Autumn's copy.
plumbing.billing/seats:counts: An organization's members and seats in full, for the Pricing and Plan and credits pages to price Team. The assistant reads the organization through organizations/queries:workspace.
plumbing.evidenceLibraries/uploads:generateUpload: A storage URL for a file the person picks in their browser.
plumbing.exports:progress: Tells the browser downloading an export when its next part is ready.
plumbing.exports:start: Registers an export the person's browser downloads at once, a part at a time.
plumbing.extraction/queries/costs:estimateJob: The extraction page's figure for a job before it starts. The assistant is given the same figure with extraction/start:extract, as the most it asks the person to approve.
plumbing.extraction/queries/costs:estimateRetry: The retry dialog's figure, the one extraction/mutations/retry:retryFailedQuestions checks the balance against.
plumbing.extraction/uploads:generateUploadUrl: A storage URL for a file the person picks in their browser.
plumbing.featureFlags/queries:list: Feature flags the pages check before showing a feature.
plumbing.openalex/limits:spend: Counts a signed-in account's OpenAlex requests for the server actions that make them.
plumbing.organizations/manage:confirmJoin: Keeps the membership Clerk made when the person accepted an invitation in Clerk's own client. The assistant doesn't accept invitations for anyone.
plumbing.organizations/manage:setLogo: Takes an image file the person picked in their browser. The assistant has no file to give it.
plumbing.organizations/queries:invitationTo: The join page's reading of one invitation to the organization at its address. The assistant reads invitations through organizations/queries:myInvitations.
plumbing.extraction/queries/jobs:runningJob: The ring the rail draws around Extract for a running extraction. The assistant reads jobs through extraction/queries:listJobs.
plumbing.organizationFeatures:get: What a page loaded before the workspace's plan decided reads; it goes with those tabs.
plumbing.organizationFeatures:opens: Whether the workspace the page is in opens Evidence Libraries, for the pages to check.
plumbing.research/records:importBatch: Imports the browser's local history once, at sign-in.
plumbing.topics/catalog:initialize: Seeds the topic catalog the first time a page needs it.
plumbing.users/mutations:ensureUser: Creates the account row when a session first signs in.
plumbing.users/mutations:syncProfileFromSession: Copies the Clerk session's name and email onto the account row.
plumbing.library/collections:deleteSoon: The Library page's delete, held for its Undo. The assistant deletes with library/collections:deleteCollection, at once, and says it can't be undone.
plumbing.library/collections:keepCollection: The Undo of the Library page's delete, within a few seconds of it. The assistant's delete has no undo.
plumbing.wallet/queries:isOriginAllowed: The connect page's check that an external app's origin is allowed.
plumbing.workspaces/queries:homeOf: Which workspace an item a page's address names is in, for the page to open it there. The assistant names items by ID in its own workspace.
plumbing.workspaces/queries:bySlug: Which organization's workspace a page's address names, for the page's own calls. The assistant acts in its chat's workspace.
plumbing.workspaces/queries:memberAt: Whether the person is still a member of the organization a page's address names, for a page left open to leave it. The assistant acts in its chat's workspace.
plumbing.workspaces/queries:personal: The workspace a page outside an organization's address is in, for the page's own calls. The assistant acts in its chat's workspace.
plumbing.zotero/actions:startOAuth: Starts Zotero's OAuth redirect, which only the person's browser can complete.
plumbing.presence:heartbeat: The browser's own signal that an item's page is still open in it.
plumbing.presence:chatHeartbeat: The browser's own signal that a chat is still open in it.
plumbing.presence:leave: A page or the panel closing an item, so its room drops the person at once.
plumbing.presence:here: Who else has an item open, for the item's first row; a room names people only.
